responsibility: Implements the GCC driver helper for %:local_cpu_detect on S/390 Linux hosts, mapping /proc/cpuinfo machine IDs and feature flags to -march=native or -mtune=native substitutions. It is responsible for host CPU name selection, z9-109 versus z9-ec differentiation, and for appending feature-disabling or ABI-selection options such as -mno-htm, -mno-vx, and -mzarch when the detected native machine lacks or implies those facilities.
